heading: Refund, Return and Replacement Policy
paragraphs: This Refund, Return and Replacement Policy applies to all services and orders provided by Arseen Enterprises LLC ('Company,' 'we,' 'us,' or 'our'), a Wyoming limited liability company. US Office Address: 15 Tanguay Ave, Suite 112 #7C, Nashua, NH 03063, United States. By placing an order or engaging our services, you agree to the terms of this policy. For questions or to submit a refund request, contact us at support@arseenenterprises.com.

How We Accept Payment. We accept payments through authorized electronic payment methods. All payments are processed in United States Dollars (USD) unless otherwise stated in your written quotation. Payment is required in full before order fulfillment begins, as stated in our Billing Policy.

Eligible Grounds for Refund or Replacement. You may be entitled to a refund, replacement, or other remedy in the following verified circumstances: (a) Non-Delivery — your order was not delivered within the agreed or reasonable timeframe and no valid tracking evidence of delivery exists; (b) Significantly Not as Described — the item received is materially different from what was confirmed in your written quotation or order agreement; (c) Incorrect Products — you received a product that does not match the confirmed specification; (d) Missing Items — part of your confirmed order was not included in the shipment; (e) Significant Transit Damage — the product arrived with damage that occurred during shipping and is documented with photographic evidence; (f) Verified Major Defects — the product has a significant manufacturing or quality defect not caused by the customer; or (g) Duplicate or Erroneous Charges — a billing error resulted in an overcharge or duplicate payment.

How to Report a Problem — Required Steps. To be eligible for a refund or replacement, you must: (1) Contact us in writing at support@arseenenterprises.com within 7 calendar days of confirmed delivery — or within 7 calendar days of the expected delivery date for non-delivery claims; (2) Include your order number, a clear written description of the issue, and supporting evidence such as photographs or video of the product and packaging, the shipping label, and any available tracking information; (3) Allow us up to 5 business days to review your report and respond with a determination or a request for additional information. We strongly encourage customers to contact us directly before initiating any payment dispute, as most issues can be resolved quickly through direct communication.

Available Remedies. Depending on the verified issue, available remedies include: corrective fulfillment, replacement of missing or incorrect items, a partial refund, or a full refund to the original payment method. The appropriate remedy is determined after review of the reported issue and supporting evidence. We aim to provide a written determination within 5 business days of receiving a complete report.

Refund Processing Timeline. Approved refunds are initiated to the original payment method within 5–10 business days of written approval. Processing time may vary depending on your payment provider or financial institution. If the original payment method is unavailable, we will work with you to arrange an alternative.

Dispute and Chargeback Rights. Nothing in this policy limits or waives any rights you may have under applicable consumer-protection laws, payment-provider dispute procedures, or chargeback rights provided by your card issuer, bank, or payment service. We will respond to all payment disputes and chargebacks promptly and in good faith. Initiating a payment dispute does not waive any rights you have under this policy or applicable law.

Non-Refundable Items. The following are generally non-refundable: (a) fees for services fully performed and delivered as confirmed in your written quotation; (b) third-party carrier charges, customs duties, import taxes, and government-imposed levies that have already been remitted on your behalf; (c) rush or expedited service surcharges where the service was performed as requested; and (d) fees for orders cancelled by the customer after procurement or fulfillment work has commenced. These exclusions do not apply where the service was not performed as agreed or where a billing error occurred.

Return of Products. Do not send product returns to the US office address unless Arseen Enterprises LLC specifically authorizes that address in writing for your specific order. Return instructions, including the correct return address and any required documentation, will be provided as part of the resolution process. Unauthorized returns may not be accepted.

Pre-Shipment Photographs. Where pre-shipment photographs or video are provided, they confirm the visible condition of a product before dispatch. They do not waive or limit legitimate claims for non-delivery, transit damage, concealed defects, missing items, incorrect products, or material misdescription.

Dispute Appeals. If you disagree with our determination, you may submit a written appeal to support@arseenenterprises.com within 15 calendar days of receiving our response. Your appeal should include any new information or arguments not previously considered. We will review the appeal and provide a final written response within 10 business days.

Consumer Protection Rights. Nothing in this policy limits or waives any rights you may have under applicable federal, state, or international consumer-protection laws or payment-provider buyer-protection programs.

Policy Updates. We reserve the right to modify this policy at any time. Changes take effect upon posting to our website with an updated 'Last Updated' date. Your continued use of our services after any changes constitutes your acceptance of the revised policy.

Contact Us. For all refund requests, billing inquiries, or questions about this policy, contact: Arseen Enterprises LLC — support@arseenenterprises.com. Our support team aims to respond within 1–2 business days. Please include your order number and all relevant details in your message.
